risks.title: Competition
risks.summary: Competition in the automotive industry remains intense and could affect market share and CarGurus' position
risks.score_rationale: CarGurus operates in a highly competitive environment with major players such as Autotrader, Cars.com, and TrueCar, requiring continuous innovation to maintain its leadership in traffic (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Technology Dependence
risks.summary: System failures or technological issues could significantly impact operations and the ability to serve customers
risks.score_rationale: CarGurus' platform relies on critical technologies and advanced algorithms for matching buyers and dealers, as well as predictive intelligence (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Regulatory Risks
risks.summary: Regulatory and legislative changes may require significant investments to remain compliant
risks.score_rationale: CarGurus operates across multiple jurisdictions (United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Ireland) with evolving regulations that may require operational adjustments (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Credit Risks
risks.summary: Defaults or credit issues among financing partners could affect financial stability
risks.score_rationale: CarGurus has partnerships with automotive financing companies for customer connection services and is exposed to payment default risks (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Cybersecurity Risks
risks.summary: Cybersecurity breaches could have severe consequences in terms of customer data loss, legal liability, and reputation
risks.score_rationale: CarGurus handles sensitive consumer and dealer data on its marketplace platform, making it vulnerable to attacks that could compromise trust and compliance (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Macroeconomic Risks
risks.summary: Economic slowdowns or recessions could significantly reduce demand for automotive transactions
risks.score_rationale: Demand for automotive marketplace services is cyclical and sensitive to economic conditions, interest rates, and consumer confidence (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Dependence on Business Partners
risks.summary: Issues with key partners could affect the quality and completeness of the platform
risks.score_rationale: CarGurus relies on dealers for vehicle inventory and on financing partners for financing and advertising services (default score, to be refined)

ai_positioning.summary: CarGurus is gradually integrating artificial intelligence into its platform, particularly through AI-powered inventory intelligence and advanced analytics solutions. Following the shutdown of CarOffer, the company is focusing on analytics technologies and sourcing intelligence rather than direct transactions.
